cardOverview.overviewText: Bank of Baroda Varunah Premium Credit Card is a premium offering designed exclusively for Indian Navy personnel, combining strong reward earnings with lifestyle and travel-focused benefits. It offers accelerated reward points on key spend categories, unlimited domestic lounge access, complimentary Amazon Prime and fitness memberships, and reduced forex markup, making it well-suited for frequent spenders and travellers.

benefitRows.name: Amazon
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail Amazon Prime membership,spend ₹1.5 lakh within 90 days of card issuance.|Receive an SMS/email with a redemption link from Bank of Baroda.|Log in using your registered mobile number, OTP, and card details.|Get your coupon code and redeem it on the Amazon Prime website.
